source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-12 from the quadratic character of GF(167). The base array has entry 1 at row x and column y when x + y is a nonzero square modulo 167 and 0 otherwise. Rows were removed one at a time, each time the kept row covering the fewest (4-set, pattern) pairs alone, down to 114 rows (programs/greedy.c, deterministic, diagonal cells set to 0). The 114 diagonal cells (x + y = 0) of the kept rows were then left free, programs/holes4w.c listed the patterns on sets of four columns that the other cells leave uncovered with the diagonal choices that cover each, and a simulated annealing search over the free diagonal cells and 16 added rows (programs/ls2m.c, seed 1, 8,000,000 moves, temperature 0.35) left 33 patterns uncovered. An exact repair that flips single cells anywhere in the array and keeps exact incremental lists of uncovered and uniquely covered patterns (programs/repi4.c, seed 1, temperature 0.25, 1 thread) reached 0 after 94 accepted flips. programs/run_recipe.sh runs every step and checks the sha256 of each file; a complete run from scratch reproduced the array exactly (programs/recipe_log.txt). Exact check with ca_verify, all 4-sets
construction: Cyclotomic (quadratic character) array for q = 167 with rows removed greedily to 114, its diagonal cells and 16 added rows chosen by simulated annealing, and exact single-cell repair
notes: answers the cited size 130 at k = 167 (tie); no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start
